name: Mobile Development Profile
description: Native Android, Native Apple iOS, Flutter Mobile, and Expo / React Native engineering

optional_specialists.trigger: Native Android application (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3)
Native Apple iOS application (Swift, SwiftUI, Apple HIG)
Native gestures, bottom sheets, transitions, and haptics for Expo/RN
Mobile security review (keystore/keychain, deep links, permissions)
Mobile UI/UX critique and accessibility audit

routing_flow: 1. Detect Framework: Exactly one of Android, iOS, Flutter, or Expo
2. Superpowers Engineering Process: Brainstorming and detailed implementation plan
3. Primary Platform Authority: Load official platform framework skill
4. Mobile Interaction Craft: Emil Kowalski native motion, gestures, and haptic feedback
5. Mobile Security: Review storage, permissions, deep links, and IPC via OWASP
6. Simulator / Device Validation: Functional QA in simulator or emulator
7. Mobile Release Verification: Accessibility (TalkBack/VoiceOver), battery, and performance
release_gate: Automated unit and widget tests pass
Accessible font scaling (Dynamic Type / fontScale) supported without text truncation
Screen readers (VoiceOver and TalkBack) correctly announce views and actions
Edge-to-edge layout renders properly behind system bars and notches
Hardware back-button and swipe gestures handle navigation safely
Permissions requested just-in-time with explicit rationale strings
Memory leak tests confirm no retaining view cycles or lingering subscriptions
